page.layout: One column of running text, with a running head and page number at the top. No marginal notes, no foot notes and no catchword.

main_text.p: degunt: ut, pisces, catus, canis marinus, porcus ma-rinus, &c.
Hisce addantur Amphibia, animantia in aquis & terris degentia: ut, cancri, lutrae, Otter [?], &c.
Substantia sentiens rationalis est quae ratione praedita est, ut Homo, creaturarum omnium nobilissimus.

head.i: Hactenus de substantijs & facultatibus: sequitur de qualitatibus.

main_text.p: Quaedam qualitates percipiuntur tactu, ut, Calor, Frigus, Humor, Siccitas.
Quaedam percipiuntur visu, ut Lux & Color.
Quaedam qualitas sentitur gustu, ut sapor laxans & astringens.
Sapor laxans est in lacte, vino dulci, melle, sacharo, oleo, butyro carne.
Sapor astringens est in pipere, zingibere, allio, cepa, sale, pomis, pyris & prunis sylvestribus vino austero, acetosa, saurampffer [?] / malo punico, grauat-apffel/aceto, bile, absinthio.
Quaedam qualitas sentitur odoratu, ut odor bonus, vel malus.
Odor bonus, ex rosa, viola, rosmarino provenit. Odor malus ex cadavere, coeno, &c.
Quaedam qualitas sentitur auditu, ut sonus acutus vel gravis.

Qui praecepta noscere cupiunt prolixiora, videant solertissimi viri Domini Doctoris Scribonij Physicam, cujus axiomata plaeraq; transcripsimus: Physicam Domini Philippi Melanchthonis, ejusq; libellum de Anima: Physicam Doctoris Thomae Frcigii. Et Herbaria, quae a Doctis viris scripta passim extant.
Hactenus Physica expofita est: ubi autem definit Physicus, ibi incipit Medicus: Recte igitur sequitur Medicina.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Otter" appears to be black letter and its letters are uncertain. "saurampffer" is uncertain at the first letter and the ff ligature. "Frcigii" is printed as shown; the name is probably Freigii, but the scan reads Frcigii. The line-end hyphen in "grauat-apffel" is printed as a small mark and was read as a hyphen. The p in "plaeraq;" and the spelling "Physicam" are as printed. The page number 347 is printed with an unclear final digit that reads as 7.
